```sql
WITH RECURSIVE
theme_tree AS (
  SELECT id FROM themes WHERE name = 'Gear'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT t.id
  FROM themes t
  JOIN theme_tree tt ON t.parent_id = tt.id
),
current_inv AS (
  SELECT set_num, id
  FROM (
    SELECT set_num, id,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY set_num ORDER BY version DESC) AS rn
    FROM inventories
  ) x
  WHERE rn = 1
),
inv_children AS (
  SELECT ci.set_num AS parent_item,
         n.item,
         CAST(n.quantity AS BIGINT) AS quantity,
         n.is_minifig
  FROM current_inv ci
  JOIN (
    SELECT inventory_id, set_num AS item, quantity, FALSE AS is_minifig
    FROM inventory_sets
    UNION ALL
    SELECT inventory_id, fig_num AS item, quantity, TRUE AS is_minifig
    FROM inventory_minifigs
  ) n ON n.inventory_id = ci.id
),
contents(item, qty, is_minifig) AS (
  SELECT set_num, CAST(1 AS BIGINT), FALSE
  FROM sets
  WHERE year = 2013
    AND theme_id IN (SELECT id FROM theme_tree)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT ic.item,
         c.qty * ic.quantity,
         ic.is_minifig
  FROM contents c
  JOIN inv_children ic ON ic.parent_item = c.item
)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(qty), 0) AS total_minifigs
FROM contents
WHERE is_minifig;
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE gear_themes AS (
  SELECT id FROM themes WHERE name = 'Gear'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT t.id FROM themes t JOIN gear_themes gt ON t.parent_id = gt.id
),
target_sets AS (
  SELECT s.set_num
  FROM sets s
  WHERE s.year = 2013 AND s.theme_id IN (SELECT id FROM gear_themes)
),
current_versions AS (
  SELECT parent_kind, parent_num, MAX(version) AS max_version
  FROM u_composition
  GROUP BY parent_kind, parent_num
),
exploded AS (
  SELECT 
    set_num AS root_set,
    set_num AS current_num,
    'set' AS current_kind,
    1 AS qty_multiplier
  FROM target_sets
  
  UNION ALL
  
  SELECT
    e.root_set,
    uc.child_num,
    uc.child_kind,
    e.qty_multiplier * uc.qty
  FROM exploded e
  JOIN u_composition uc 
    ON uc.parent_num = e.current_num 
    AND uc.parent_kind = e.current_kind
  JOIN current_versions cv 
    ON cv.parent_kind = uc.parent_kind 
    AND cv.parent_num = uc.parent_num 
    AND cv.max_version = uc.version
  WHERE e.current_kind IN ('set', 'minifig')
)
SELECT SUM(qty_multiplier) AS total_minifigs
FROM exploded
WHERE current_kind = 'minifig'
```
